notes: Scores are subjective visual assessments, not computed similarity to the photograph.
Earlier numerical cloth-solver steps are separate and excluded.
Failed screenshot retries remain attached to their original candidate and are not counted again.
Durable JPEG evidence is verified here; some original scratch PNGs were not retained by the runtime restore.
